Routines

top source red::headerinfo_copystep

SST pipeline

red::headerinfo_copystep, filename_or_header, old_filename_or_header [, /all] [, anchor=string] [, /last] [, prpara_add=dictionary] [, prstep=string] [, stepnum=integer]

Copy FITS info about a processing step from one FITS header or file to another.

Parameters

filename_or_header in type=strarr

The FITS header in which to write the step info. If only one element or a scalar string, interpreted as the name of a file from which to read the header. Note: needs to be a filename if any of the step keywords are are variable keywords.

old_filename_or_header in type=strarr

The FITS header from which to read the step info. If only one element or a scalar string, interpreted as the name of a file from which to read the header. Note: needs to be a filename if any of the step keywords are are variable keywords.

Keywords

all in optional type=boolean

Copy info for all available steps.

anchor in optional type=string

Position the step info after the specified keyword.

last in optional type=boolean

Copy info for the last available step.

prpara_add in optional type=dictionary

A prpara dictionary (see red_make_prpara) with additional parmeters to add to the PRPARAn keyword.

prstep in optional type=string

Copy info for steps matching this string.

stepnum in optional type=integer

Copy info for the step with this (these) number(s).
